<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Lovely Bulldog 50</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by sonusng - https://uiverse.io/sonusng/lovely-bulldog-50 */
/* From Uiverse.io by sonusng - Tags: input */
input {
  width: 210px;
  height: 50px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid #fe4567;
  color: #f9f9f9;
  animation: shake_541 0.14s 3;
}

input:valid {
  border-color: #45feaf;
  animation: none;
}

@keyframes shake_541 {
  0%, 100% {
    translate: 0;
  }

  25% {
    translate: 8px 0;
  }

  75% {
    translate: -8px 0;
  }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input required="" type="text" placeholder="Your Name">
</body>
